# OAPEN Library

> OAPEN Library is an open access repository for peer-reviewed scholarly monographs and chapters across humanities, social sciences, and applied fields.

OAPEN (Open Access Publishing in European Networks) Library provides free access to high-quality academic publications from international publishers including Routledge and Taylor & Francis. The platform supports interdisciplinary research spanning health humanities, environmental studies, African development, linguistics, and urban planning.

## Browse & Discover

- [Recently Added](https://library.oapen.org/recent-submissions): Browse newly submitted open access scholarly works and publications in the OAPEN Library collection

## Health & Environmental Humanities

- [Chapter: Insects](https://library.oapen.org/handle/20.500.12657/112098): Academic handbook chapter on insects by Campbell, Sim, and Bates covering health and environmental humanities perspectives, including integrated pest management approaches

## African Development & Security

- [Security-Development Nexus in Africa](https://library.oapen.org/handle/20.500.12657/112094): Academic research examining the interconnections between security and development challenges across African contexts by Duma and Mashimbye
- [3rd Conference of Planning Students and Young Graduates](https://library.oapen.org/handle/20.500.12657/112096): Conference proceedings on spatial planning, urban development, and smart cities initiatives in African contexts

## Linguistics & Language Studies

- [Prof. Eqrem Çabej në Albanologji dhe në gjuhësinë europiane](https://library.oapen.org/handle/20.500.12657/112097): Historical linguistics study examining Prof. Eqrem Çabej's contributions to Albanian studies and European linguistic correspondence
